declared difference (issue #895): a call to a probe-then-reload helper (a name with both "probe" and "reload") is
the recovery, so p1 is clean; p2 has the call but no lastOk* key (NOT-KEYED); p3's call is in a comment and p4 only
declares the helper (NO-RECOVERY); p5's name has no "probe" (NO-RECOVERY).

WARN  lint-spa-poll-no-recovery  @DIR@/p2.js:2  setInterval/setTimeout poll loop 'poll()' reloads, but the recovery is not keyed on time since the last success (no lastOk* timestamp set from a clock in the poll body and compared) -- a failure-count or reload-on-error watchdog is blind to a hung request; key it on lastOkAt (types/dashboard.md Poll loop reliability)

import { probeThenReload } from "./recover.js";
function poll() { lastOkAt = Date.now(); a().catch(e => 0); }
setInterval(poll, 1);
if (Date.now() - lastOkAt > 60000) probeThenReload();
